messages:
Nora (Product): quick thread to crystallize what goes into the pilot for the new inference "Optimize" guidance: batching templates, caching playbook + small SDK helper, quant profiles + eval-triggered alerts. we need clear acceptance criteria and owners. keep it lean.
Sam (Eng-ML): agree on lean. big risk is silently degrading customer quality when quant kicked in. we should require a per-customer prompt set baseline and a rollback window.
Ravi (Solutions): customers want concrete examples: web chat (short-turn), document-embed (long seq), rerank (batch requests). can we ship 3 sample configs aligned to those?
Ivy (SRE): telemetry requirements: batch size histogram, cache_hit_ratio, quant_fallback_count, p95/p99 token latency. those must exist before pilot. also need automated alerting playbook entries.
Lena (Product Ops): proposed acceptance checklist (pilot must meet all):
- Observability: dashboards with all telemetry metrics in Console for pilot orgs.
- Performance: p95 latency <= baseline_p95 * 1.15 for latency-first policy; cost-first should show >=10% token-cost reduction on Streamly traces.
- Quality: normalized eval score drop <= 1.0% vs baseline on curated prompt set per customer.
- Safety: automatic fallback path implemented (can be toggled off by customer).
- Docs: playbook + runbook + 3 sample config snippets published.
Sam (Eng-ML): quality delta = (baseline_score - test_score) / baseline_score * 100. we'll use acceptability + semantic-similarity metric ensemble.
Kai (Eng-Platform): implementation note: batching templates + routing plug-ins can be delivered as router yaml snippets + a lightweight runtime flag. caching SDK helper (prefix-hash + TTL helpers) is a small lib we can ship in 2 weeks. quant calibration jobs need infra to run per-model; prototype in 3 weeks.
Ravi (Solutions): ACME (safety-focused) wants default: no aggressive-quant; fallback must be manual toggle default ON for them (i.e., auto-fallback OFF). Streamly (cost-focused) wants cost-first preset + auto-fallback ON.
Ivy (SRE): runbook alerts to add:
- p95_latency increase > 20% over last 1h -> alert P1
- cache_hit_ratio < 45% for 10m -> investigate
- eval_quality_drop > 1.0% (on customer baseline) -> automatically flag rollout and, if enabled, trigger fallback to non-quant model
- fallback_triggered > 3 times in 10m -> page oncall
Sam (Eng-ML): sample heuristic for docs:
```
batch_policy:
  id: cost-first-small
  target_latency_ms: 50
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  batching_mode: adaptive
  pad_strategy: dynamic
```
Kai (Eng-Platform): sample cache config snippet for docs:
```
cache_strategy:
  kind: prefix-kv
  prefix_keys: ["user_prompt", "conversation_state"]
  ttl_seconds: 300
  invalidation_examples: ["user edits message", "session_reset"]
```
Lena (Product Ops): rollout gating plan:
1) internal Canary (10% traffic) -> pass telemetry checks for 48h
2) ACME pilot -> run acceptance tests with Solutions team
3) Streamly pilot -> run acceptance tests
4) Gradual ramp with canary phasing and auto-fallback enabled for cost tenants
Nora (Product): decisions we need today: 
- threshold for quality rollback = 1.0% (consensus?)
- autoscale UI excluded from v1 (ship later)
- owners & timelines
Sam (Eng-ML): 1.0% OK from eng side, but we'll provide per-model notes if baseline variability high.
Ivy (SRE): confirm autoscale UI out of scope. we still want hooks for autoscaler to consume batch metrics but no UI.
Nora (Product): owners & ETA: Sam -> batching templates + quant proto + eval integration (3w); Kai -> caching SDK + metrics + docs (2w); Ivy -> dashboards + alerts config (1.5w); Ravi -> customer acceptance scripts + sample traces (1w); Lena -> playbook + runbook + kickoff + pilot orchestration (1w).
Ravi (Solutions): I'll assemble the 3 workload traces and coordinate a 60-min ACME validation session next Tue.
Sam (Eng-ML): one more: propose an eval command to standardize on customer side:
```
redwood-eval run --model model:v1 --prompts customer_prompts.json --baseline baseline_scores.json --out results.json
```
Lena (Product Ops): must-have launch gates before we call pilot "ready": dashboards live, two pilots signed off, docs + runbooks published, and one successful canary (48h).
infra-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync on Wednesday 10:00 in #product. :calendar: 
Nora (Product): OK wrapping up. will update PRD with acceptance checklist and owners, and circulate meeting invite for kickoff. :white_check_mark:
